'''BigJoint BHBM/TYFP''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[BigJoint]]
* '''Published:''' 3 June 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed BHBM BigJoint DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

first turn i pull and deploy palpy, docking bay, emperors power an try to get somone at the docking or just draw.then i just go and beat down with vader, maul and friends with palys power i always get 2 destiny and this is a high destiny deck :) i rarely convert luke i usually just beat down or take him to throne room and just kick his ass in the duel for 3 force loss + drains a turn.
